change: Correct applicability for intentionally absent observations before fresh scored runs. Preserve all v1 artifacts as incomplete; never relabel them as v2 passes.

fixed-05-ambiguous-foot.condition: The permitted focused clarification passes intent, location and guidance checks.

fixed-08-hard-radius.condition: The controlled source proves every eligible specialist lies outside the explicit hard radius; retrieval/filter failure cannot qualify.

native_language_exception.condition: Inspect source text and requested response language. Every relevant displayed original must already use that language. Application translation status alone is not evidence.

fault_requirements: Original text, ownership, explicit unavailable status and bounded failure handling must pass even when translation faithfulness is null.
translation_coverage_requirement: Each predefined case must supply at least two real translated original reviews and score at least 4/5. Every required translation on the first page must be present and faithful. Synthetic translations cannot supply this coverage.
adaptive_admission: Both fixed and fixture phases complete; all assertions and source checks pass; every applicable fixed-case dimension is at least 4/5; predefined real translation coverage passes; root attests to the matching application, manifest and protocol hashes.
final_gate: All adaptive cases complete; every applicable dimension is at least 4/5; all source and constraint checks pass; required translation coverage is satisfied. Report nulls separately, never as passed scores or an average.
reporting: each null and its predefined reason
